_comment: Per-platform performance baselines, compared by `cargo run -p sunrise-bench --bin baseline -- --check target/criterion bench/baseline.json 60`. Nothing enforces them and nothing updates them automatically. The bench-regression job in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on schedule and workflow_dispatch only — never on a pull request — carries continue-on-error: true, and passes a 60% tolerance rather than the 5% docs/10-cross-cutting/performance-budgets.md specifies, because on the shared runner the same binary swings +270% (ws_handshake) and −39% (submit_create_task) against its own recorded baseline. So this file is edited by hand, in a commit that says what changed and why. A null is a metric never measured on that platform. See performance-budgets.md §Regression policy and https://github.com/justin13888/Sunrise/issues/33.
